description: Write in-app message copy with AI from a short brief: eyebrow, title, message and button labels sized for the layout. Returns text only; nothing is saved. Button links are never invented, so add urls before using the copy in a step.

brief.description: What the message should say, 3-1000 characters, e.g. 'trial ends in 3 days, nudge them to upgrade'.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

format.description: Message layout (default modal); sets length targets.

hasImage.description: True when the step shows an image.

name: write_in_app_copy

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `write_in_app_copy` MCP tool.

copy.description: eyebrow, title, body and buttons ({label, action}) to put in an in-app step.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
